import urllib.request
import json

def get_ensembl_lookup(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{gene_symbol}?expand=1"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            canonical_transcript = None
            for t in data.get('Transcript', []):
                if t.get('is_canonical') == 1:
                    canonical_transcript = t
                    break
            return {
                'id': data.get('id'),
                'seq_region_name': data.get('seq_region_name'),
                'start': data.get('start'),
                'end': data.get('end'),
                'gene_length': data.get('end') - data.get('start') + 1,
                'canonical_transcript_id': canonical_transcript.get('id') if canonical_transcript else None,
                'canonical_length': canonical_transcript.get('length') if canonical_transcript else None,
                'Translation': canonical_transcript.get('Translation', {}).get('length') if canonical_transcript and canonical_transcript.get('Translation') else None
            }
    except Exception as e:
        return str(e)

print("UGT2A1 Ensembl:", get_ensembl_lookup("UGT2A1"))
print("AGPAT2 Ensembl:", get_ensembl_lookup("AGPAT2"))

import urllib.request
import json

def get_ncbi_gene_info(symbol):
    # search gene ID
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        gene_id = data['esearchresult']['idlist'][0]
    
    # get gene summary
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        summary = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['result'][gene_id]
        
    return gene_id, summary

print("UGT2A1:", get_ncbi_gene_info("UGT2A1"))
print("AGPAT2:", get_ncbi_gene_info("AGPAT2"))

def get_transcripts_proteins(symbol):
    # Search nuccore
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        gene_id = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['esearchresult']['idlist'][0]
    
    # query elink for protein
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&db=protein&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        links = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        protein_ids = [link['id'] for link in links['linksets'][0]['linksetdbs'][0]['links']]
    
    # get protein lengths
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(protein_ids[:10])}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        prot_sum = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['result']
        prots = [(prot_sum[pid]['caption'], prot_sum[pid]['title'], prot_sum[pid]['slen']) for pid in protein_ids[:10] if pid in prot_sum]
    return prots

print("UGT2A1 proteins:", get_transcripts_proteins("UGT2A1"))
print("AGPAT2 proteins:", get_transcripts_proteins("AGPAT2"))
